correctness.rationale: For n=13,14, the complete ordered-complement-triple certificates are independently checked against all disconnected induced triples. A definition-level purity test and a pairwise shelling-witness test both pass, with respectively one and eight spanning facets; the pure-shelling theorem yields integral sphere wedges. For n=3..8, exhaustive three-subset checks find no facets. For n=9..12, exhaustive all-face binary boundary reductions produce nonzero lower-dimensional reduced homology (degrees and ranks 3:1, 4:11, 5:1, 7:2), contradicting shellability of a pure complex. For n>=15, published Theorem 1.4 of arXiv:2603.23155v1 applies after p=3 substitution, with multiplicity binomial(n-6,2)-20. The verifier was executed from the actual artifact directory and returned VERIFY_OK; finite checks are not extrapolated to the infinite tail.
risks: Reliance on the standard pure-shelling homotopy theorem and published n>=15 theorem, not independently reproven here.
